title: approvals: after the reject-requires-reason change (#35716, #35741), the contract docblock, object comment, docs, checklist and skill reference still say a reject reason is optional — bring them in line
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czKnDE6hsyXQzB9wB2

Filing gate: ② contract review S2 on PR #35741 (record 7032134627) — the texts that PR defers, filed so its `Skills-docs:` line can name them. ⛔ Not a claim.

**What.** #35716 (merged) made `approval_reject` require a reason; #35741 makes `ApprovalService.decide`, `POST /api/v1/approvals/requests/:id/reject` and `client.approvals.reject` require it too. Once #35741 lands, these still read as if a reject reason were optional or action-scoped:

- `packages/spec/src/contracts/approval-service.ts` — `ApprovalDecisionInput.comment?` and the `IApprovalService.decide` docblock say nothing of the reject rule (the contract-bearing one; the `outputs` member beside it states its own approve-only rule there).
- `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-request.object.ts` — the comment above `approval_reject.params`: "The target route itself does not judge the reason." becomes false.
- `content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx` — `body: { actorId?, comment? }` for reject (~774) is false; the decision-surface table row and the `approval_reject` paragraph are action-scoped.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/approvals.json` — the quorum step posting `/reject` with no body; the `r`-key step that confirms with nothing typed.
- `skills/objectstack-automation/references/state-machines-and-approvals.md`, "Recording a decision" — teaches `decide()` and `POST …/reject` without the reason.

**Ask.** Rewrite each so a reject requires a non-blank reason at every human door (action, route, service, SDK, console), naming the email action link as the one exception until #35722 lands. Text only; no behaviour change. `packages/spec` and `skills/**` may be governed surfaces: check `check-governed-merges.mjs` on the final file list.

Blocked-by: #35741 (texts describe its behaviour).
Suggested-grade: p2 · docs/contract truth for a shipped narrowing.
Dedupe: `reject reason optional docs`, `ApprovalDecisionInput comment` (searched before filing).
